name: jevmem
description: jevmem: automatic project memory for Claude Code, and its side pane

plugins.name: jevmem
plugins.description: Say it once. jevmem saves the decisions, rules and failed approaches from your Claude Code chats to JEVMEM.md in your repo, brings the relevant ones back next session, and checks commands against your saved rules. Needs the jevmem CLI from npm and a TypeSafe API key. Opt-in per project.

plugins.name: jevmem-pane
plugins.description: A side pane for Claude Code beside your chat: what jevmem recalled for this prompt, what its guard decided, and what the last turn saved, with why, wrong and forget buttons. Reads three local files in .jevmem/ and runs the jevmem command; sends nothing anywhere. Needs the jevmem CLI, a project that is turned on, and Claude Code 2.1.299 or newer.
